answer: The GAO AI Accountability Framework states that inadequate separation between the training and testing data could result in overfitting, meaning the model may perform well during testing but underperform in the operational environment when it encounters unfamiliar data. It emphasizes the need for documentation of the rationale for organizing the data and how it is segregated into training, development, and testing sets prior to model development to allow third-party assessment of the appropriateness of the data segregation.
